mapper.insert: INSERT INTO security_orders (account_id, security_id, order_type, order_method, order_price, quantity, status, ordered_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{securityId}, #{orderType}, #{orderMethod}, #{orderPrice}, #{quantity}, #{status}, #{orderedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT security_order_id, account_id, security_id, order_type, order_method, order_price, executed_price, quantity, status, ordered_at, executed_at FROM security_orders WHERE security_order_id = #{securityOrderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE security_orders SET status = 'FILLED', executed_price = #{executedPrice}, executed_at = #{executedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE security_order_id = #{securityOrderId}
UPDATE security_orders SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE security_order_id = #{securityOrderId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select:
SELECT so.security_order_id, so.account_id, so.security_id, sec.ticker, sec.name, so.order_type, so.order_method, so.order_price, so.executed_price, so.quantity, CASE WHEN so.executed_price IS NOT NULL THEN so.executed_price * so.quantity ELSE NULL END AS executed_amount, so.status, so.ordered_at, so.executed_at FROM security_orders so JOIN securities sec ON so.security_id = sec.security_id
ORDER BY so.ordered_at
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT security_order_id, account_id, security_id, order_type, order_method, order_price, executed_price, quantity, status, ordered_at, executed_at FROM security_orders WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND order_method = 'LIMIT' AND security_id = #{securityId}
mapper.update: UPDATE security_orders SET status = 'FILLED', executed_price = #{executedPrice}, executed_at = #{executedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE security_order_id = #{securityOrderId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE security_orders SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND DATE(ordered_at) = CURDATE()
mapper.select: SELECT security_order_id, account_id, security_id, order_type, order_method, order_price, executed_price, quantity, status, ordered_at, executed_at FROM security_orders WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND DATE(ordered_at) = CURDATE()
